answer: Gate each identity behind a verifiable delay function (VDF): before drawing from the shared nectar pool, an agent must publish a VDF proof requiring ten minutes of strictly sequential computation that extra cores cannot speed up. One machine can mint only a few identities per hour, while verification is instant, like checking an opal against the light. The lagoon of rewards stays shallow for attackers: forging a thousand Sybils needs a thousand machines running in parallel for ten minutes, turning a cheap flood into a hardware bill larger than anything the fake identities could extract.
